results.notes: VbaoLabScene.tsx:314 calls render(activeAo, activeView, productOutput) with a user-toggled boolean. The productOutput parameter and its branches are live code.
vbaoRawPipeline and vbaoRawAoPipeline are used in the else branches of the productOutput conditional, which IS exercised by VbaoLabScene.
computeAsync and textureNode are defined in vbaoComputeCandidate.ts return object but no caller references them. Only compute() is used.
VBAO_THETA_MAX is exported but never imported. VBAO_THETA_RANGE is only used internally for VBAO_THETA_STEP computation. Both can be made non-exported.
Deprecated VBAONodeOptions fields are public API. Removal requires migration plan and major version bump. Keep for now but track.
Each test assigns ownerTerm a constant string then immediately asserts it equals that same string. These assertions always pass regardless of solver correctness.
Tests verify constants equal specific arrays — tests the constant definition, not behavior.
Tests verify VBAO_SAMPLING_SCHEME etc. equal literals — self-documenting constants don't need freeze tests.
Source-string tests in vbaoNodeSource.test.ts are intentionally brittle to enforce shader invariants. Refactoring to behavioral tests requires domain expertise.
dot3(), angularSamples(), PIXEL/NORMAL constants are copy-pasted across 6 test files.
Numeric thresholds like 0.55, 0.9, 4 appear without geometric reasoning comments.
maskRangeFn and intervalMaskStochasticFn are duplicated between VBAONode.ts and VBAOReceiverConfidenceNode.ts.
Vec3 math functions (dot3, add3, sub3, etc.) are duplicated in aoRaycastReference.ts and vbaoReference.ts.
SampleableNode type alias defined identically in 5 files.
clamp01 helper duplicated in VBAOHalfResCleanupNode, VBAOFullResPolishNode, reference/vbaoReceiverConfidence.
clampResolutionScale duplicated in VBAOHalfResCleanupNode and VBAOReceiverConfidenceNode.
SSAO code in MuseumScene.tsx and aoPipelines.ts serves different rendering contexts. Extraction may require careful interface design.
Many type aliases in MuseumScene.tsx just add 'n/a' to existing types. Low-value indirection.
8 decorative section markers (// ─── ... ───) in VbaoScene.tsx add visual noise without documentation value.
Comment 'Setup complete — the async function returns here' restates obvious control flow.
SECTOR_COUNT JSDoc explains the value is 32 when it's visible. Only the WHY (WGSL optimization) matters.
Error message lists every construction-time parameter by name instead of a general statement.
Extensive JSDoc on interfaces where field names are already descriptive.
Runtime null check on normalNode may be defensive for dynamic usage patterns. Needs domain context.
